task: Day 4 (Thursday) — File Handling, Multithread & SOAP (T4.1–T4.8): Apache POI Excel export for bookings + multithreaded Excel import for tours (ThreadPoolTaskExecutor fan-out) + Spring WS SOAP currency conversion integrated into tour detail page
acceptanceCriteria: T4.1: BookingExcelExporter generates styled .xlsx (header #BDD7EE, alternating rows) via Apache POI XSSFWorkbook
T4.2: GET /admin/bookings/export streams .xlsx file with current filter params (keyword/status/fromDate/toDate)
T4.3: importExecutor ThreadPoolTaskExecutor bean (core=5, max=10, CallerRunsPolicy) declared in AsyncConfig
T4.4: TourExcelImporter reads all POI rows to String[][] on calling thread (thread-safety), then fans out to importExecutor via CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(); workers parse+validate only (no JPA)
T4.5: Flyway V9 migration creates tour_import_jobs table; TourImportJob entity + TourImportJobRepository wired
T4.6: POST /admin/tours/import processes .xlsx upload, records job, returns result; GET /admin/tours/import/template downloads blank template
T4.7: currency.xsd defines CurrencyConversionRequest/Response; Spring WS SOAP endpoint at /soap/*; WSDL at /soap/currency.wsdl
T4.8: TourController.tourDetail() calls SOAP client for USD+EUR prices; tours/detail.html shows '≈ X USD / ≈ Y EUR' below VND price
blastRadius: TourController.tourDetail(): additive SOAP call — returns null on failure, tour detail still renders
AdminBookingController: new export endpoint only — existing list/detail/confirm/cancel unchanged
AdminTourController: new import endpoints only — existing CRUD unchanged
AsyncConfig: new importExecutor bean — additive only, existing notificationExecutor unaffected
SecurityConfig: /soap/** added to CSRF ignore + permitAll — additive, no existing rules changed
contracts: SOAP: CurrencyConversionRequest (amount, fromCurrency, toCurrency) → CurrencyConversionResponse (convertedAmount, rate, fromCurrency, toCurrency) at /soap/currency
ExcelExportService: exportBookings(keyword, status, fromDate, toDate) → XSSFWorkbook
ExcelImportService: importTours(MultipartFile, Long createdBy) → TourImportJob; generateTemplate() → XSSFWorkbook
TourExcelImporter: parseRows(Sheet, Map<String,Long>) → List<ImportRowResult> (fan-out to importExecutor)
